class.name: TweensGdScheduler
class.description: Use [method add] or [method add_all] to start definitions, then call [method update] with deltas in seconds. Use Godot's main thread. The automatic [code]Tweens.play[/code] API drives a scheduler per scene tree. C# equivalent: [code]TweenScheduler[/code].

method.name: add
method.description: Starts one definition and returns its playback handle. Node targets must be in the tree and own their playback. Other Objects may use an in-tree Node owner or run without an owner under this manual scheduler. A rejected start returns a failed handle. C# equivalent: [code]scheduler.Add(target, definition, owner)[/code].

method.name: add_all
method.description: Starts an Array of definitions in parallel on one target and returns a group. Ownership follows [method add]. Invalid Array entries reject before any start; a rejected start cancels earlier members and prevents later starts.

method.name: cancel_all
method.description: Cancels every active tween. The scheduler remains usable.

method.name: cancel_owner
method.description: Cancels active tweens owned by [param owner], optionally including descendant owners.

method.name: dispose
method.description: Ends every active tween with RUNNER_DISPOSED and releases the scheduler. Safe to call repeatedly.

method.name: update
method.description: Advances one process mode by a finite, nonnegative [param delta] in seconds. An omitted [param unscaled_delta] (-1) uses delta. Tweens added during callbacks advance on the next update. Recursive updates are rejected. C# uses null instead of -1 for omitted unscaled delta.

method.name: add_chain
method.description: Snapshots a nonempty flat list on one target. Each signed delay links to the previous entry's own end. Binding and capture occur at activation. One Chain counts as one scheduler root.

members.member: Number of unfinished tweens, including paused tweens.
True after [method dispose]. New starts are rejected.
Most recently reported scheduler error, or an empty string.

signal.name: error_reported
signal.description: Emitted after a failed tween is cleaned up, with its error message.
